text:
Mira: quick overnight ramp snapshot — dropping what I did / blockers / today
Mira: what I did: kicked off prewarm in AMS1 and FRA for model-x, validated prefix cache priming (small perf win).
Mira: blocker: GCP-eu quota prevented spillover from AMS1 at ~78% (we tried to spin 12 nodes, quota denied).
Mira: today: ask infra to request temporary quota or enable reserve-slot fallback; I can also flip canary to smaller batch size to lower need.
Ravi: saw the same — logs show repeated OOMs on a few older nodes during warmup, likely kernel mismatch.
Ravi: workaround deployed: drain policy to avoid <p2.xlarge> instances, put a sticky tag on recently patched nodes.
Kai: FYI the quota request form is filled (ticket INFRA-4821) but cloud-side approvals take ~4 hrs. Can we short-circuit with reserved slots?
Jules: reserved slots available in EWR but not in GCP-eu. Would need cross-cloud routing, which is low-risk but needs routing config.
Mira: @Jules can you post the routing flag? I can test a canary switching AMS1->EWR if ops agrees.
Jules: route flag is --prefer-region=ewr in the routing service. small test command: `curl -X POST https://router.internal/route -d '{"model":"model-x","prefer":"ewr"}'`
Kai: ops-bot reported spot-eviction spike at 02:10 UTC, eviction window lasted ~7m, we saw retry storm that consumed headroom.
ops-bot: incident signal: spot-eviction spike detected in GCP-eu (02:10 UTC). Auto-fallback executed to dedicated pool where available.
Ravi: suggested short-term: reduce batch_size from 16->8 for model-x during peak ramp to halve instance pressure. Mia (typo) — Mira ack? :slightly_smiling_face:
Mira: ack, I'll queue a canary change (batch_size=8) and watch tailing metrics.
Mira: long-term ask: can infra request an emergency +10 GPUs to GCP-eu for next 12hrs if quota can't be moved? That avoids user-facing throttles.
Jules: will try emergency quota escalation, pinging cloud reps now.
Kai: note for oncall: add a quick runbook step to check `kubectl get nodes -l patched=true` before warmup to avoid OOM nodes.
Ravi: created PR #5493 to add prewarm health-checks and batch override flag.
Mira: blockers now: waiting on INFRA-4821 and cloud rep reply. If we get green, next steps: canary batch change + routing fallback test.
Ravi: ok, I'll watch the canary and hold oncall page for 2hrs after rollout.
Jules: update in thread when quota ticket changes state. I'll also post a short runbook snippet once PR merges.
Mira: thanks — end of quick standup. :coffee:
